label: Manage projects
title: Manage projects
description: Every project you belong to, with your permissions in each. Copy one to start a new project from its setup. Owners can delete a project; members can leave one. Deleting permanently removes the project and everything in it.
empty: You are not a member of any project yet.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes {name} and everything in it: issues, comments, attachments, and settings. This cannot be undone.

leaveDialog.title: Leave {name}?
leaveDialog.description: You will lose access to {name} and its work items. To join again you need a new invite from an owner.
